author: GameTrailers
description:
With all-new trailers and reveals, the Convergence Games Showcase unites influencers and indie developers to champion the variety, creativity and passion for play behind every release.

#IGN
title: Convergence Games Showcase – October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the ‘Welcome to Inaba’ Trailer for Persona 4 Revival, the remake of the classic action RPG developed by Atlus. Players will explore the region of Inaba to meet characters, engage in adventures, and make sense of the mystery of the Midnight Channel. Persona 4 Revival is launching on February 18, 2027, on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Persona 4 Revival - Official Welcome to Inaba Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Behind-the-Scenes Trailer for The Wolf Among Us Remastered, a narrative-driven adventure game developed by Telltale. Players will experience the thrills of classic folklore with a modern twist as Bigby and company. Hear from the development team on bringing this classic title to the current generation of hardware with The Wolf Among Us Remastered, launching on October 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), with a release coming soon on Nintendo Switch.
title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered - Official Behind-the-Scenes Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Triple-i Initiative returns with 40 announcements in 45+ minutes including Dave the Diver, Risk of Rain 2, Windrose, Brotato, Among Us Story, Militsioner, Outward 2 & more, PLUS eight new game reveals!. Tune in October 8th at 9am PDT/12pm EDT/6pm CEST.

#IGN
title: The Triple-i Initiative October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Cinematic Trailer for March of Giants, a free-to-play MOBA strategy action game developed by March of Giants Team. Players can get a new look at the intense warfare they will partake in as armies clash on the battlefield. Embody a towering Giant, master powerful abilities, and take victory once and for all. March of Giants is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.
title: March of Giants - Official Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the gameplay trailer for Marvel Tokon's first DLC character, Phoenix Cyclops. First appearing in Avengers Vs X-Men, Phoenix Cyclops is the Phoenix Force-possessed version of Scott Summers, Cyclops. Able to make use of both his concussive optic blasts from his visor and the destructive Pyrokinesis of the Phoenix Force, Phoenix Cyclops fights for the survival and dominance of mutant-kind! Phoenix Cyclops is launching on November 2 in Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam)
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Official Phoenix Cyclops Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Legion Was Here, a dark humor detective puzzle game developed by Geoffroy Monde. Players will solve mysteries through unorthodox methods by stealing clients' faces and identities to carry out dangerous missions while not getting caught in the process. Legion Was Here is launching on October 13 for PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Legion Was Here - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the new Progression trailer for the DMZ mode included in Modern Warfare 4. The mode has been signficantly retooled since Modern Warfare 2, introducing the F.O.B (Forward Operating Base) where you can spend skill points to upgrade your operator, use cash to purchase weaponry and customise weapons. Using materials and cash, you can upgrade your vendor stations, letting you craft improved gear for use in the field. 

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 - Official DMZ Progression Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Frozen Trail Arrives Trailer for ARC Raiders, a third-person extraction shooter developed by Embark Studios. Players will take on the trials and tribulations of the North with the new Frozen Trail update that will take Raiders to an all-new region with unseen enemies to encounter. The Frozen Trail Update for ARC Raiders launches on October 8 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: ARC Raiders - Official Frozen Trail Arrives Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the launch trailer for Riders Republic Season 20! Introducing two new brand of scooters into the mix, as well as the celebration for 5 years of Riders Republic. Jump in and earn exclusive rewards throughout the season. 
Riders Republic is out now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Ubisoft Connect, Epic Games Store, Steam), Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Riders Republic - Official Season 20 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Amiko Legends, a creature-collecting extraction RPG developed by Aurory. Players will explore a vibrant open world to seek out Amiko, gain their favor, and extract resources along the way. Amiko Legends is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Amiko Legends - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Cheating is very much encouraged in The Devil's Due, the upcoming roguelite card-dueling poker game in which you lost your soul in a poker game against The Devil. Win it back – if you can. The Devil's Due will be released on PC on November 10. Wishlist it and play the demo on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699850/The_Devils_Due/
title: The Devil's Due: Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get your first look at the frozen, kill-or-be-killed world of Frostrail in this upcoming survival FPS. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3517740/Frostrail/
title: Frostrail: Official First Look Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: With October 6th 2026, Final Fantasy VII Ever Crisis ended service after 3 years, having originally released in September 2023. To mark the end of service, Square Enix released a thank you video looking back at the game, check it out!
title: Final Fantasy VII Ever Crisis - Official Final Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Building a Home Trailer for Croakwood, a town-building management game developed by Texel Raptor. Players will live a life of leisure as frogs get comfortable in the wild woods. Get a brief look at assembling a house in Croakwood, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Croakwood - Official Building a Home Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest official story trailer from the fan-favorite Action RPG, Genshin Impact! Genshin Impact is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC.
title: Genshin Impact - Official "Bygone Days" Story Teaser

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Not Alive Enough, a first-person zombie shooter developed by Stones Games. Players must ensure the safety of survivors at a checkpoint while fending off the undead. Not Alive Enough is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Not Alive Enough - Official Announcement Trailer
